title: The Adventures of Captain Callisto
tagline: Hop across floating platforms in space and grab every star.
blurb: You play an astronaut hopping between floating platforms, collecting stars and using a jetpack that runs dry fast. It's short and cute, and the jump timing is tighter than it looks.
desc: The Adventures of Captain Callisto, a 3D platformer by Cody Ebberson. Hop across floating platforms in space and collect the stars. Free in your browser.
author: Cody Ebberson
controls: W A S D or arrows to move
Shift or X for the jetpack
tags: callisto platformer space astronaut stars jetpack jump webgl js13k
extraCredit: It was made for the js13kGames 2021 contest, so the whole game fits in 13 KB zipped.
